variant: Android experimental Better Mi Fitness Sync fork; healthlab.7 cloud-read-only batch reconciliation of already-matching pending SpO2
build_result: Release main and matching instrumentation APKs built successfully. Actual binary manifests match healthlab.7/1000013. 519 Android JVM/host tests passed, with zero failures, errors or skips. Generated Android module outputs were cleaned in a separate invocation before the build to prevent stale resource IDs.
validation_scope: 519 Android JVM/host tests using synthetic records, count-shaped fixtures, fake cloud responses, memory-backed journal fixtures, one real temporary PreferencesDataStore file close-and-reopen test, and four real loopback HTTP transport tests. Main/test APK compilation, signatures, binary manifests, ZIP integrity, license assets and baseline profile checked. No phone installation, user-account read/write, instrumentation execution, Windows PowerShell execution, official Mi Fitness UI check, physical device reboot/process kill/disk failure or iOS build by the assistant.

prior_version_user_feedback.interpretation_limit: Successful bounded queries returned no matching active default-SID targets for the pending identities. This does not prove remote non-persistence. Ordinary MISSING also includes targets returned only as deleted or under a different explicit SID. Changed counts from .4 are not evidence of fifteen recovered rows.

feedback_changes: Phone action reconcile all pending SpO2 and PC mode reconcile-pending read the cloud but upload zero health rows. Only actually observed matches can update local pending state.

Combine all broad/native observations before classification. Tombstones, other or unknown SIDs and content conflicts take precedence over a match from another view. Incomplete history leaves absent targets unqueried.
Commit all eligible local reconciliations in one DataStore transaction with per-target pending/recovery CAS. Preserve consumed budgets, latest business metadata and observed-only upload provenance.
Report a disjoint candidate outcome partition, distinguish local CAS changes from persistence failures, and keep new-upload counters at zero.

Real temporary PreferencesDataStore is closed, joined and reopened to verify pending, recovery budget, observed fingerprints and business metadata persistence. This is not a physical process-death test.
Phone actions share the sync/session lock and an independent result panel. inspect remains no local journal mutation; only the two health-write PC modes require AllowCloudWrite.
limitations: Passing offline tests does not prove acceptance by a particular Xiaomi account or App display.
HC HRV source is RMSSD; Xiaomi native HRV algorithm remains unconfirmed. Experimental summaries do not reconstruct baseline, scoring, full-night beat-interval RMSSD, or detailed curves.
No confirmed conditional field-update/CAS endpoint; enrichment double-read narrows but cannot eliminate concurrent-client races.
Latest weight sync retained; no dedicated S400 Pro Mi Home/member historical fallback.
No addition to official Zepp HC read capabilities or private receiving endpoints.
Any rejected source currently suppresses daily aggregation across the selected range; unresolved raw rows also defer daily writes. Raw persistence does not guarantee Mi Fitness charts.
Unverified earlier date groups that become visible later are reconciled at the next normal sync precheck; no extra end-of-run sweep or automatic POST retry.
The three RHR source instants are absent from the user log; .5 only merges distinct-time observations. True same-instant contradictions still reject the date.
A different existing cloud RHR value is still protected; an observed lower daily value does not authorize automatic replacement.
Pending reads are observations, not proof of absence or remote API completeness; the new probe does not unlock pending rows.
The live RHR single-record path verifies RAW only, without the normal-sync daily display check.
The instrumentation harness and PowerShell driver are built/reviewed but not run on a user device or on Windows.
Android replay protection applies to MiDataClient default transport; iOS URLSession behavior and arbitrary injected clients are not covered.

older_version_user_feedback.interpretation_limit: Diagnostic v1 omitted failure reasons, source issue codes and verification-status partitions. Synthetic fixtures reproduce count shapes; they do not establish actual private-source causes or App display.

prior_feedback_changes: Continue independent raw-date groups after accepted POST plus healthy but semantically unverified readback; retain pending locks and never automatically resend uncertain writes.
Bounded GET-only readback pauses of 1000 and 3000 milliseconds.
Classify unmatched-sleep HRV samples as exclusions/warnings while retaining rejected ambiguous or invalid sources.
Diagnostic v2 includes failure reasons, source issue counts, existing/new/unattempted counts, pending/conflict/ambiguity partitions and allowlisted field mismatch counts.
Preserve partial verified progress at both metric and overall-run level; keep incomplete tasks incomplete.
Retain detail and copyable diagnostic for nonempty-source zero-mapped NoData outcomes.
Run the read-only RHR daily diagnostic after source-rejected partial outcomes only when all mapped selected raw targets are verified.
Reject conflicting equal-latest HC revisions instead of selecting by page order; preserve exact duplicate deduplication.
Clear stale earlier upload/batch context when reporting later PREPARE or PRECHECK failures.

prior_version_user_feedback.interpretation_limit: With the complete pasted diagnostic, absent precheck mismatch fields imply all 147 pending rows were MISSING in that preflight query. This does not prove cloud non-persistence. RHR source instants were excluded, so distinct-time observations cannot be distinguished from same-instant contradictions from the old report.

feedback_changes: Use native-evidenced minimum of valid actual RHR observations at different source instants per source date; retain same-instant/revision conflicts and all source associations.
Attach bounded read-only broad/narrow pending probes to incomplete normal imports and device inspection; never change journal state or infer retry authorization from missing reads.
Provide a separate same-signer instrumentation APK and PowerShell driver: default inspect; explicit sync-one selects at most one RAW target and no DAILY target.
Isolate live tests before Application startup; block ordinary coordinator/worker sync and display a minimal Activity without home-profile refresh.
Disable automatic Android health-data POST-body replay, including connection recovery, redirects and 503 Retry-After follow-ups; verify with real localhost fixtures.
Keep diagnostic read observations separate from uploaded/verified progress; diagnostics export only allowlisted fields and counts.

healthlab6_recovery_limits: No server-side idempotence, atomicity or exactly-once guarantee has been established. A single explicit extra attempt can still encounter a previously persisted but invisible record.
Old journals did not retain full request or business-outcome provenance. A matching old identity/content/source digest cannot prove the original outer timezone or HTTP envelope.
Native diagnostic control is capped at five pages; recovery is capped at 32 pages. Without explicit valid pagination completion, missing is unqueried/incomplete and no recovery write is made.

Repeated recovery cannot skip a consumed oldest unresolved target within the same source plan. Changing or sliding the time range can change which target is oldest; the persistent budget is per target.
Uninstalling/clearing application data destroys local history and is not a recovery procedure. The old weight-reset action is no longer linked to health-import pending.
One verified RAW recovery neither repairs the other pending targets nor establishes official Mi Fitness display. No DAILY record is created by recovery.
Assistant cannot access the user USB phone from the cloud environment; the compiled phone action and optional PC driver still require real-device execution.

feedback_changes: Phone sync page exposes an explicit one-pending-SpO2 recovery action. Device-test mode recover-one-pending uses the same implementation; it requires the write flag and only accepts spo2.

Inspect/normal pending probes add a bounded native no-start-time history control and counts for deleted/other-source occupancy. These probes never mutate the journal or increase normal verified counts.

Recovery checks one oldest in-range pending target against current source identity, content, source association and known timezone; it checks broad/native/final-narrow views and requires complete native traversal before treating missing as eligible for the explicit extra attempt.

Recovery persists a per-account/per-target CAS reservation before its sole health upload. Cancellation, rejection, response loss or process restart cannot reauthorize that target. A partial native read can positively confirm an observed match but cannot establish absence.
Normal RAW sync protects every previously verified identity from automatic re-upload when a later query omits it, with a separate blocked_verified_history_rows counter.
UI recovery, ordinary sync, background keepalive and home profile refresh share a session-mutation lock. The old weight retry setting no longer clears health-import pending state.
Preserve previous transport no-replay protections, RHR day policy, metric mappings and diagnostics privacy; no fake health values, source timestamps or source IDs introduced.

latest_user_device_feedback_unchanged: The most recent supplied device diagnostic is still healthlab.5 SpO2: 195 source targets, 63 existing matches, 132 pending, zero attempted health uploads. No new .6/.7 user device report was provided for this implementation.
healthlab7_reconciliation_limits: This improves local reconciliation workflow, without evidence that the user 132 targets are available through any current cloud view.
Current source-plan pending only; unavailable/deleted HC source history and out-of-window pending are outside this action.
One endpoint traversal ending does not prove historical non-persistence, nor official App display or future retention.
All-broad-matched targets can reconcile without native traversal. Otherwise, native traversal is capped at 32 pages and unresolved absent targets stay unqueried if incomplete.
Source-plan REJECTED problems with unknown target attribution conservatively block that plan; no automatic rewrite or arbitrary source selection.
No automated transition from batch reconciliation to health upload; explicit single recovery remains separate with its existing durable budget.
